We present a Wannier-orbital-based formulation of the transient-polaron-localization (TPL) framework for quantitative charge-transport simulations in crystalline pi-conjugated polymers. By expressing all interactions directly in a Wannier representation derived from first-principles calculations, the approach avoids artificial fragmentation of polymer backbones and enables a consistent, material-specific description of electronic couplings and electron-phonon interactions. Low- and high-frequency vibrational modes are incorporated within a mode-resolved TPL formalism, yielding an effective electronic Hamiltonian that captures both dynamic disorder and polaronic renormalization. The methodology is demonstrated for the ambipolar crystalline naphthalenediimide-bithiophene copolymer, enabling a direct comparison of electron and hole transport along the polymer backbone and pi-stacking directions. The simulations reproduce key transport features, including pronounced anisotropy and higher electron than hole mobility. Additional studies on single- and bi-chain systems reveal the essential role of inter-chain coherence in supporting efficient transport along the polymer backbone. Beyond this specific system, the Wannier-orbital-based TPL framework provides a transferable route to disentangle intrinsic charge-transport mechanisms in crystalline pi-conjugated materials and establishes a foundation for future work.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于Wannier轨道的瞬态极化子局域化（TPL）框架，用于定量模拟结晶性π共轭聚合物的电荷输运。该方法直接从第一性原理计算导出Wannier表示，统一描述电子耦合和电子-声子相互作用，并通过模式分辨的TPL形式捕获动态无序和极化子重整化效应。在双极性萘二酰亚胺-联噻吩共聚物上验证了该方法，成功复现了各向异性输运和电子迁移率高于空穴的实验特征，并揭示了链间相干性对沿聚合物骨架高效输运的关键作用。
AI.motivation: 结晶性π共轭聚合物的定量电荷输运模拟需要同时准确描述扩展共轭效应和材料特异的电子-声子相互作用，但现有方法难以在统一框架中兼顾两者，且常人为分割聚合物骨架导致物理失真。
AI.method: 将瞬态极化子局域化（TPL）框架重新表述于Wannier轨道基组中，所有相互作用均从第一性原理直接导出；采用模式分辨的TPL形式分别处理低频和高频振动模式，构建包含动态无序和极化子重整化的有效电子哈密顿量。
AI.result: 在萘二酰亚胺-联噻吩共聚物上成功复现了显著的各向异性输运以及电子迁移率高于空穴的特征；单链和双链系统研究表明链间相干性对沿聚合物骨架的高效输运至关重要。
AI.conclusion: 该Wannier轨道基TPL框架为结晶性π共轭材料中本征电荷输运机制的解析提供了可迁移的通用路径，为后续研究奠定了方法论基础。

title: Cross-Temperature Defect Identification in Atomistic Simulations via Multi-Level Domain Alignment
summary: Identifying atomic defects at elevated temperature is difficult because thermal fluctuations blur the local symmetry that both geometric heuristics and supervised classifiers rely on: trustworthy labels exist in low-temperature reference configurations, while the high-temperature regime where robust analysis matters most is effectively unlabeled. We cast this as a cross-temperature domain-shift problem and align the two domains at three levels: an equivariant denoiser at the input level, cross-temperature contrastive learning at the representation level, and a morphology-aware regularizer that steers predictions toward the compact geometry of physical defect structures. Because no atom-wise truth exists at temperature, we further introduce a label-free evaluation suite that scores predicted defect structures along five spatial and physics-based axes, enabling model assessment and selection without high-temperature labels. Near the melting point, the framework identifies vacancies and self-interstitial atoms across face-centered-cubic, body-centered-cubic, and hexagonal-close-packed iron systems with every interstitial localized and zero false detections in every vacancy system against Wigner-Seitz ground truth, with no high-temperature labels used in training. It sustains this fidelity on a million-atom, 2.5 ns trajectory, resolving single vacancy hops and complete Frenkel-pair recombination, and captures grain-boundary phase transformations in aluminum bicrystals, distinguishing two nucleation modes. Multi-level domain alignment thus offers a practical, label-efficient route to temperature-robust structural analysis of large-scale molecular dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种跨温度域对齐框架，用于在高温下识别原子缺陷。通过等价去噪器、跨温度对比学习和形态学正则化三个层面的域对齐，在无需高温标签的情况下，实现了近熔点温度下FCC、BCC、HCP铁体系中的空位和自间隙原子检测，并在百万原子级轨迹中保持高保真度。
AI.motivation: 高温下识别原子缺陷存在根本性困难：热涨落模糊了局域对称性，使得基于几何启发式或监督分类器的方法失效。可信标签仅存在于低温参考构型中，而最需要鲁棒分析的高温区间实际上是没有标签的。这构成一个跨温度的域偏移问题。
AI.method: 将问题建模为跨温度域偏移问题，在三个层次进行域对齐：(1) 输入层：使用等价去噪器（equivariant denoiser）；(2) 表示层：跨温度对比学习（cross-temperature contrastive learning）；(3) 预测层：形态学感知正则化器（morphology-aware regularizer）引导预测趋向物理缺陷结构的紧凑几何。此外，提出无需标签的评估套件，沿五个空间和物理轴对预测缺陷结构进行评分。
AI.result: 在近熔点温度下，框架在FCC、BCC、HCP三种铁体系中成功识别空位和自间隙原子，所有间隙原子均被定位，空位体系零误检（对照Wigner-Seitz地面真值），且训练过程中未使用任何高温标签。在百万原子、2.5纳秒轨迹上保持保真度，能够解析单空位跳跃和完整的Frenkel对复合。此外还捕捉了铝双晶中的晶界相变，区分了两种成核模式。
AI.conclusion: 多层次的域对齐为实现温度鲁棒的结构分析提供了一条实用且标签高效的路径，尤其适用于大规模分子动力学模拟中的缺陷识别任务。

title: Competing Extended-$s$- and $d$-Wave Pairing from Distinct Spin-Fluctuation Channels in Stoichiometric $\mathrm{FeTe}$
comment: 5 pages and 5 figures in Main text, 8 figures in Supplementary Material
summary: The recent observation of superconductivity in stoichiometric $\mathrm{FeTe}$ raises the question of how pairing develops in this tetragonal 11-type chalcogenide once interstitial Fe is removed. We construct an experimentally constrained five-orbital tight-binding model from first-principles calculations and treat electronic correlations and pairing within the fluctuation-exchange approximation. The linearized Eliashberg equation yields competing extended-$s$- and $d_{x^2-y^2}$-wave spin-singlet pairing instabilities. Near stoichiometric filling, spin fluctuations near $(π,0)$ and $(0,π)$ in the unfolded one-Fe Brillouin zone connect the $Γ/M$ hole pockets with the $X/Y$ electron pockets and favor an extended-$s$ gap that changes sign between the hole and electron sheets. Upon electron doping, depletion of the hole pockets shifts the dominant scattering toward the $X$--$Y$ channel near $(π,π)$, making the $d_{x^2-y^2}$-wave state the leading instability, with nodal lines that avoid most of the Fermi surface. The relative strengths of the two pairing channels vary with filling and interaction strength as the dominant spin-fluctuation channel changes. Under matched interaction strength, temperature, and filling, the extended-$s$ eigenvalue is larger in $\mathrm{FeTe}$ than in $\mathrm{FeSe}$ throughout the range considered, while the $d_{x^2-y^2}$-wave eigenvalue is also generally larger, particularly under electron doping. These results give concrete gap structures against which spectroscopic measurements of stoichiometric $\mathrm{FeTe}$ can be compared.

AI.tldr: 本文通过第一性原理构建实验约束的五轨道紧束缚模型，结合涨落交换近似研究化学计量比FeTe的超导配对机制。线性化Eliashberg方程给出扩展s波和d波两种竞争配对不稳定性，并分析了它们随填充和相互作用强度的变化。
AI.motivation: 最近实验在化学计量比FeTe中发现超导电性，关键在于去除间隙Fe后配对如何形成。需要理解这种四方11型硫族化合物的超导配对机制。
AI.method: 从第一性原理构建实验约束的五轨道紧束缚模型，利用涨落交换近似处理电子关联和配对，通过求解线性化Eliashberg方程分析配对不稳定性。
AI.result: 在近化学计量填充下，(π,0)和(0,π)附近的自旋涨落连接Γ/M空穴口袋与X/Y电子口袋，有利于变号扩展s波能隙；电子掺杂下空穴口袋减少使主导散射转向X-Y通道(π,π)附近，d_{x^2-y^2}波成为主导不稳定性。扩展s波本征值在FeTe中大于FeSe。
AI.conclusion: 给出化学计量比FeTe的具体能隙结构，为光谱测量提供理论对比基础。两种配对通道的相对强度随填充和相互作用强度而变化，取决于主导自旋涨落通道的转变。

title: Coarse-grained kinetic scale tightens thermodynamic spectral bounds of Markov cycles
summary: Thermodynamic bounds on the spectrum of a Markov cycle depend on the cycle affinity and maximum escape rate, but they ignore how the local transition rates are distributed around the cycle. In this work, we show that a single additional cycle-wide kinetic quantity, the geometric means of forward and backward rates, yields a strictly stronger bound for every nonuniform cycle. By comparing each winding sector of the eigenmode with a product-matched uniform cycle, we bound oscillation frequencies, tighten the admissible spectral region, and show that only uniform cycles can saturate the Uhl-Seifert boundary. Our results show that retaining a coarse-grained kinetic scale can sharpen thermodynamic spectral bounds without requiring knowledge of the full generator. Our method also provides a complex-analytic framework which unifies generator-specific kinetic information with established affinity-winding bounds.

AI.tldr: 本文表明，在马尔可夫环的谱热力学界中，引入一个额外的环级动力学量（正反向速率的几何平均值），可以在每个非均匀环上获得比仅依赖亲和力和最大逃逸率更强的界，并证明只有均匀环才能饱和Uhl-Seifert边界。
AI.motivation: 现有的马尔可夫环热力学谱界仅依赖于环亲和力和最大逃逸率，忽略了局部跃迁速率在环上的分布信息，导致界不够紧致。作者希望纳入更细粒度的动力学信息来提升谱界的精度。
AI.method: 通过将每个缠绕扇区（winding sector）的本征模与一个乘积匹配的均匀环（product-matched uniform cycle）进行比较，利用正反向速率的几何平均值作为额外的环级动力学量，并采用复分析框架统一了生成元特异的动力学信息与已有的亲和力-缠绕界。
AI.result: 该方法对每个非均匀环都产生了严格更强的界，收紧了对振荡频率的限制及可容许谱区域，并证明只有均匀环才能饱和Uhl-Seifert边界。
AI.conclusion: 保留一个粗粒化的动力学尺度（几何平均速率）即可显著锐化热力学谱界，无需知道完整生成元信息，为热力学谱理论提供了更一般且实用的统一框架。

title: Quantics tensor cross interpolation for high-order strong-coupling expansions
summary: Real-time impurity solvers enable the study of transport phenomena and the description of nonequilibrium lattice systems within the framework of dynamical mean-field theory (DMFT). They also provide direct access to the spectral functions of both equilibrium and nonequilibrium systems. A widely used approach is the self-consistent strong-coupling expansion, whose lowest-order implementation corresponds to the non-crossing approximation. Higher-order implementations, however, are computationally demanding because the number of diagram topologies grows factorially with expansion order, while the evaluation of self-energies and Green's functions requires increasingly high-dimensional integrations. Here, we demonstrate that the latter challenge can be mitigated by employing quantics tensor cross interpolation in a variable-separated framework. Compared with the previously used scale-separated approach, the new scheme yields substantially lower bond dimensions and capacitates self-consistent steady-state DMFT calculations up to fourth order. We illustrate its performance with representative results for both equilibrium and photo-doped systems. In addition, we analyze the convergence of the strong-coupling expansion in the challenging noninteracting limit by computing diagrams up to sixth order. At this order, the onset of the asymptotic regime of the strong-coupling expansion becomes apparent, which allows the application of extrapolation techniques.

AI.tldr: 本文提出使用量化张量交叉插值（quantics tensor cross interpolation）在变量分离框架下加速实时杂质求解器中的高阶强耦合展开计算，将自洽稳态DMFT计算能力提升至四阶，并计算到六阶以分析强耦合展开的渐近行为。
AI.motivation: 实时杂质求解器是研究非平衡晶格系统输运现象和谱函数的关键工具，但高阶强耦合展开（超越非交叉近似NCA）的计算成本极高，因为图解拓扑数量随展开阶数阶乘增长，且自能和格林函数需要高维积分。这限制了DMFT计算的精度和适用范围。
AI.method: 采用量化张量交叉插值（QTCI）在变量分离框架下处理高阶强耦合展开中的高维积分问题，替代此前使用的尺度分离方法，从而降低张量分解的键维（bond dimension），实现自洽稳态DMFT计算至四阶，并计算至六阶以观测强耦合展开的渐近行为。
AI.result: 新方案相比尺度分离方法获得了更低的键维，成功实现了四阶自洽稳态DMFT计算；对平衡态和光掺杂系统均展示了代表性结果；在非相互作用极限下计算到六阶，观测到强耦合展开渐近区域的起始，并可通过外推技术进一步处理。
AI.conclusion: QTCI方法有效缓解了高阶强耦合展开的高维积分瓶颈，将DMFT计算推进到更高阶，并揭示了强耦合展开在六阶时进入渐近区域，为应用外推技术提供了可能性。

title: A Comprehensive Study of Charge-Carrier Mobility in Double Lateral-Gate Silicon Junctionless Transistors
summary: We give in depth overview of charge-carrier mobility in p-type silicon double lateral-gate junctionless transistors (DLGJLT) through a mix of computer simulations and experimental results. The devices were built on low-doped silicon-on-insulator substrates using atomic force microscope nanolithography. Because the design uses air-gap side gates instead of a gate-oxide layer or junction, it allows electrical current to flow through a lightly doped silicon channel. This setup reduces impurity scattering and protects transport quality from interface damage. We used three-dimensional TCAD Sentaurus simulation tool to model the device's electrical behavior and confirm our experimental data for transconductance and drain conductance. We attempt to give a comprehensive view on the charge transition within the device.

AI.tldr: 本文通过计算机模拟与实验相结合的方式，深入研究了p型硅双横向栅无结晶体管（DLGJLT）中的载流子迁移率。器件采用原子力显微镜纳米光刻技术在低掺杂SOI衬底上制造，利用气隙侧栅设计替代传统栅氧化层或结，使电流通过轻掺杂硅沟道，从而减少杂质散射并保护输运质量。通过三维TCAD Sentaurus仿真验证了跨导和漏导的实验数据，全面揭示了器件内的电荷输运机制。
AI.motivation: 传统结型晶体管中，栅氧化层和结的存在会引入界面损伤和杂质散射，影响载流子迁移率和输运质量。作者希望通过无结、无栅氧化层的创新器件结构，配合气隙侧栅设计，来减少这些不利因素，从而获得更优的电荷输运性能。
AI.method: 1）采用原子力显微镜纳米光刻技术在低掺杂SOI衬底上制备p型双横向栅无结晶体管；2）使用气隙侧栅替代传统的栅氧化层或结结构；3）利用三维TCAD Sentaurus仿真工具对器件电学行为进行建模；4）将仿真结果与实验测得的跨导和漏导数据进行对比验证。
AI.result: 通过TCAD仿真成功复现了实验中的跨导和漏导数据，验证了器件模型的准确性。气隙侧栅和轻掺杂沟道的设计有效降低了杂质散射并避免了界面损伤，从而改善了载流子迁移率。研究对器件内部的电荷传输和转变过程提供了全面的分析。
AI.conclusion: 该研究展示了一种无需栅氧化层和结的新型无结晶体管设计，通过气隙侧栅和轻掺杂硅沟道的组合，有效减少了散射并保护了输运质量。仿真与实验的一致性验证了该器件结构的可行性和优越性，为未来无结器件的设计与优化提供了重要参考。

title: Importance-Reweighted Fock-Space Variational Monte Carlo
summary: Fock-space variational Monte Carlo (FS-VMC) evaluates variational quantities by stochastic sampling over discrete many-body configurations. For ab initio electronic Hamiltonians, Born distributions can differ markedly between systems, and a Markov chain that mixes well need not yield low-variance estimators. We introduce importance-reweighted FS-VMC (IR-FS-VMC), which leaves the variational objective unchanged while redesigning its Monte Carlo evaluation. An auxiliary distribution and Hamiltonian-guided proposal define the Markov chain, while an evaluation Markov kernel defines an analytically tractable evaluation distribution. Self-normalized importance reweighting then recovers the Born-distribution expectations entering the energy, gradient, and stochastic reconfiguration (SR) matrix. Controlled comparisons on equilibrium H2O and Fe2S2 separate Markov-chain acceptance from local-energy fluctuations and optimization behavior. Using one production protocol, calculations for H2O dissociation, 36-site hydrogen lattices, and Fe2S2 and Fe4S4 active spaces yield accurate variational energies across different Born distributions and electronic-correlation regimes. Together, these results show that the production protocol can support robust FS-VMC optimization across the electronic-structure regimes studied here.

AI.tldr: 本文提出重要性重加权Fock空间变分蒙特卡洛（IR-FS-VMC）方法，通过辅助分布和哈密顿量引导的提议分布设计马尔可夫链，并利用自归一化重要性重加权恢复Born分布期望，在不改变变分目标的前提下显著改善FS-VMC的估计质量和优化鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: FS-VMC在处理从头算电子哈密顿量时，Born分布在系统间差异显著，混合良好的马尔可夫链不一定产生低方差估计量，导致能量、梯度和SR矩阵估计不稳定，影响变分优化效果。
AI.method: 保持变分目标不变，重新设计蒙特卡洛评估过程。引入辅助分布和哈密顿量引导的提议分布定义马尔可夫链，通过评估马尔可夫核定义解析可处理的评估分布，再利用自归一化重要性重加权恢复Born分布期望，用于能量、梯度和随机重配置（SR）矩阵计算。
AI.result: 在平衡态H2O和Fe2S2上的对照实验表明该方法能分离马尔可夫链接受率与局域能量涨落及优化行为的影响。生产协议应用于H2O解离、36位氢晶格、Fe2S2和Fe4S4活性空间计算，均在不同Born分布和电子关联能区获得准确的变分能量。
AI.conclusion: IR-FS-VMC的生产协议能在所研究的电子结构区间内支持稳健的FS-VMC优化，兼顾了不同的Born分布和电子关联强度，展示了该方法的通用性和实用性。

title: Universality of superdiffusion in simple random graphs
summary: Random walks with long-range jumps can drive superdiffusive transport, replacing ordinary diffusion with an effective long-range kinetic operator. Such superdiffusive kinetics is also central to critical phenomena, notably the self-avoiding walk with long-range jump statistics, or Lévy-SAW. This work investigates how the critical behavior is affected when the long-range connectivity itself becomes random. We study self-avoiding walks (SAWs) on a one-dimensional long-range random ring graph, where bonds are independently generated with Bernoulli probability $\sim|i-j|^{-(1+σ)}$. We term this walk Sparse-SAW. The same random bonds are responsible for both long-range superdiffusive transport and quenched disorder, with both simultaneously controlled by the single parameter $σ$, placing the problem beyond the conventional Harris and Weinrib-Halperin frameworks. Through large-scale Monte Carlo simulations and a Gaussian-truncated field theory, we show that Sparse-SAW belongs to the same universality class as the clean superdiffusive Lévy-SAW. The random bonds generate short-range uncorrelated and long-range correlated mass disorder while simultaneously producing the long-range kinetic operator. Under coarse-graining, the latter dominates, restoring the clean critical behavior. Our study suggests that the full non-Gaussian Bernoulli statistics may lead to disorder physics beyond the conventional theory of quenched disorder, while establishing random graphs as an efficient platform for extracting the critical exponents of the clean superdiffusive Lévy-SAW universality class.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在一维长程随机环图上的自回避行走（Sparse-SAW），其中键以伯努利概率随机生成。研究表明，尽管存在淬火无序，Sparse-SAW与无随机性的超扩散Lévy-SAW属于同一普适类，因为长程动力学算子在大尺度粗粒化后主导行为，恢复干净的临界行为。
AI.motivation: 经典的自回避行走（SAW）和超扩散动力学在临界现象中至关重要，但此前研究未考虑长程连接本身随机化的情况。当长程连接随机化时，随机键同时产生超扩散输运和淬火无序，由单一参数σ控制，超出了传统Harris和Weinrib-Halperin框架的适用范围，需要新的理论研究。
AI.method: 通过大规模蒙特卡洛模拟和Gaussian截断场论方法，研究一维长程随机环图上的Sparse-SAW。随机键服从伯努利分布~|i-j|^{-(1+σ)}，同时用于生成长程跳跃核与淬火无序。
AI.result: Sparse-SAW与干净的超扩散Lévy-SAW属于同一普适类。随机键产生的无序在高斯图像下包含短程不相关和长程相关的质量无序，但在粗粒化过程中，长程动力学算子占主导，恢复干净的临界行为。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明完整的非高斯伯努利统计可能产生超出传统淬火无序理论的新物理，同时确立随机图作为提取干净超扩散Lévy-SAW普适类临界指数的有效平台。

title: Anomalous stabilization of excitons by metallic proximity
summary: Metallic environments are generally expected to suppress excitons through strong dielectric screening, yet their influence can differ in composite systems where metallic and insulating regions coexist. Here, we investigate excitonic states in PdxCu1-xCrO2 thin films across a percolation-driven metal-insulator transition. Optical spectroscopy and many-body GW calculations show that CuCrO2 hosts strongly bound excitons with a binding energy of about 489 meV. With increasing Pd substitution, the system approaches an insulator-to-metal transition near x = 0.5, consistent with the site-percolation threshold of a triangular lattice. In the pre-percolation regime, the excitonic resonance redshifts by 241 meV while the Tanguy continuum onset remains nearly unchanged, consistent with a substantial increase in exciton binding energy before metallization. An image-charge-based excitonic hydrogen model shows that isolated metallic regions can enhance electron-hole binding through image-charge interactions, whereas conventional screening is recovered once a continuous metallic network forms. Although this model provides a possible interpretation of the observed excitonic evolution, an alternative scenario in which metallic and excitonic responses originate from electronically distinct states and evolve independently cannot be excluded. These results reveal unusual metallic-excitonic coexistence near a percolation-driven metal-insulator transition and suggest nanoscale metallic proximity as a possible route for modifying excitonic interactions.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过光学光谱和GW计算，探究了PdxCu1-xCrO2薄膜在逾渗驱动的金属-绝缘体转变附近的激子行为。发现CuCrO2中激子结合能约489 meV，随着Pd替代接近逾渗阈值(x≈0.5)，激子共振红移241 meV而连续谱起始几乎不变，表明结合能显著增大。基于镜像电荷的激子氢模型显示，孤立的金属区域可通过镜像电荷相互作用增强电子-空穴结合，而连续金属网络形成后恢复常规屏蔽效应。研究揭示了逾渗转变附近金属-激子共存的异常现象。
AI.motivation: 金属环境通常被认为会通过强介电屏蔽抑制激子，但在金属和绝缘区域共存的复合体系中，金属对激子的影响可能不同。作者希望探究在有金属和绝缘相共存的逾渗驱动金属-绝缘体转变体系中，激子的行为如何演化，以及纳米尺度的金属邻近效应是否能为调控激子相互作用提供新途径。
AI.method: 采用光学光谱实验测量PdxCu1-xCrO2薄膜的激子共振和Tanguy连续谱；结合多体GW计算确定CuCrO2的激子结合能；利用基于镜像电荷的激子氢模型解释激子结合能在逾渗前增强的现象，并与传统介电屏蔽模型进行对比。
AI.result: (1) CuCrO2中激子结合能约489 meV；(2) 当x≈0.5时发生绝缘体-金属转变，符合三角晶格位点逾渗阈值；(3) 逾渗前激子共振红移241 meV，而连续谱起始几乎不变，表明激子结合能显著增大；(4) 镜像电荷模型表明孤立金属区域可增强电子-空穴结合，连续金属网络形成后恢复常规屏蔽。
AI.conclusion: 研究发现逾渗驱动的金属-绝缘体转变附近存在异常的金属-激子共存现象，表明纳米尺度金属邻近效应可能是调控激子相互作用的潜在途径。但作者也指出，不能完全排除金属和激子响应来自电子学上不同态并独立演化的替代解释。

title: Estimating the Fisher information from ARPES in general two-band models
comment: 7 pages 4 figures main, 6 pages 7 figures appendix
summary: The Quantum Fisher information is frequently studied in the fields of quantum sensing and quantum metrology, as it specifies the sensitivity of a sensor through the Crámer-Rao bound, and in condensed matter physics where it relates to the quantum metric. Measuring the quantum Fisher information is therefore of significant current interest. In this work, we propose a scheme for measuring the quantum Fisher information with respect to any parameter in a general two-band solid state system using angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy with carefully tuned incidence angles and light polarization. We investigate conditions under which this can be related back to information about the ground state of the material itself changing with system parameters.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种利用角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）测量一般两带固态系统中任意参数的量子Fisher信息（QFI）的方案，通过精细调节入射角和光偏振来实现。
AI.motivation: 量子Fisher信息在量子传感、量子计量学（通过Crámer-Rao界规定传感器灵敏度）以及凝聚态物理（与量子度量相关）中具有重要地位，因此测量QFI具有很高的研究价值。
AI.method: 提出一种利用角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）的方案，通过仔细调谐入射角和光偏振来测量一般两带固态系统中任意参数的量子Fisher信息。
AI.result: 研究了在何种条件下，所测量的QFI可以关联回材料基态随系统参数变化的信息。
AI.conclusion: 该方案为实现QFI的实验测量提供了可行途径，并探讨了其与材料基态性质之间的联系条件。

title: Generalizing Abell-Tersoff bond-order potential with explicit high-order many-body correlations for robust extrapolation of potential energy surfaces
summary: Machine-learning interatomic potentials enable accurate and efficient atomistic simulations, but their reliability for out-of-distribution configurations far beyond the training domain remains a significant challenge. Here, to tackle this challenge, we introduce a semiparametric interatomic potential based on a generalization of the Abell--Tersoff bond-order potential, with a chemically informed functional form and explicit high-order many-body correlations. The model is trained and evaluated on various datasets, including silicon, carbon, water, and small molecules, achieving interpolation accuracy comparable to that of existing MLIP models while demonstrating better extrapolation to unseen configurations, including those under high-pressure and high-temperature conditions. These results demonstrate that physically motivated constraints incorporated into the functional form can improve the extrapolation behavior of interatomic potentials, providing insights into the inductive biases that can be used to control extrapolation in machine-learning interatomic potentials.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于Abell-Tersoff键序势广义化的半参数化原子间势，将化学启发的函数形式与显式高阶多体关联结合，在硅、碳、水和小分子等数据集上达到与现有MLIP相当的插值精度，同时在高压力和高温等未见配置下展现出更好的外推能力。
AI.motivation: 机器学习原子间势虽然能实现准确高效的原子模拟，但在训练域之外的分布外配置中的可靠性仍然是一个重大挑战。作者希望通过在函数形式中加入物理约束来改善模型的外推行为。
AI.method: 提出一种半参数化原子间势，基于Abell-Tersoff键序势的广义化，采用化学启发的函数形式并包含显式的高阶多体关联。模型在多个数据集（硅、碳、水、小分子）上进行训练和评估。
AI.result: 该模型在插值精度上与现有MLIP模型相当，但在未见配置（包括高压和高温条件）下展现出更好的外推性能。
AI.conclusion: 函数形式中融入的物理约束可以显著改善原子间势的外推行为，这为设计可控制外推能力的机器学期原子间势提供了归纳偏置方面的洞见。

title: Comparative Assessment of Thermal Transport Theories: Dual-Channel Mechanism Dictates Heat Transport in Ultralow-$κ$ Materials
summary: Anomalous heat transport in strongly anharmonic crystalline solids poses both a fundamental challenge to the theoretical understanding and an opportunity for thermoelectric and thermal barrier coating applications. Although Green-Kubo theory reproduces experimental thermal conductivity ($κ$) at high temperatures, it lacks microscopic insight and neglects the Bose-Einstein statistics of lattice vibrations. On the other hand, the conventional Boltzmann transport equation (BTE) framework, based on a phonon-gas picture, fails due to strong anharmonicity-induced overdamped phonons. Herein, the thermal transport properties in TlAgSe, a metal chalcogenide, and Cs$_2$PbI$_2$C$_2$, an all-inorganic layered Ruddlesden-Popper perovskite, are investigated by explicitly accounting for temperature-dependent lattice dynamics through machine learning interatomic potentials and employing the Wigner transport equation (WTE) framework. Crucially, heat conduction is governed not only by higher-order phonon scattering-dominated populations' transport channel described within the BTE, but also by a coherences' channel in the WTE framework arising from wave-like interbranch coherence between eigenstates. Incorporating four-phonon scattering, WTE predicts average room-temperature $κ$ values of 0.31 Wm$^{-1}$K$^{-1}$ (TlAgSe) and 0.38 Wm$^{-1}$K$^{-1}$ (Cs$_2$PbI$_2$C$_2$), in excellent agreement with experiments. Phonon scattering-rate analysis reveals strong coherences' contributions and prevalent overdamped phonon modes, demonstrating the breakdown of the conventional BTE framework based on the phonon quasiparticle picture with only first-order anharmonic perturbation. This computational approach provides a unified description of heat transport in ultralow-$κ$ materials, offering a basis for the rational design of phononic and thermoelectric devices.

AI.tldr: 本文通过机器学习原子间势和Wigner输运方程框架，研究了两种超低热导率材料（金属硫族化物TlAgSe和层状钙钛矿Cs₂PbI₂C₂）中的反常热输运现象，证明了在强非谐晶体中相干通道对热导率的显著贡献，并预测的室温热导率与实验高度吻合。
AI.motivation: 强非谐晶体中的反常热输运既对理论理解构成根本挑战，也为热电和热障涂层应用提供机遇。传统格林-久保理论缺乏微观洞察且忽视玻色-爱因斯坦统计，而基于声子气体图像的BTE框架因强非谐导致的过阻尼声子而失效，因此需要更完善的理论框架。
AI.method: 该研究通过机器学习原子间势显式考虑温度依赖的晶格动力学，采用Wigner输运方程（WTE）框架，同时纳入四声子散射，分别考察了BTE描述的声子粒子输运通道和WTE中由波状支间相干性产生的相干通道，并对两种代表性材料进行了系统性计算。
AI.result: WTE预测TlAgSe和Cs₂PbI₂C₂的室温平均热导率分别为0.31和0.38 Wm⁻¹K⁻¹，与实验值高度吻合。声子散射率分析显示强烈的相干贡献和普遍存在的过阻尼声子模式，直接证明了基于一阶非谐微扰的声子准粒子图像BTE框架的失效。
AI.conclusion: 该计算方法为超低热导率材料中的热输运提供了统一描述，建立了超越传统声子准粒子图像的理解范式，为声子器件和热电装置的设计提供了理论基础与预测工具。

title: Mechanistic Phase-Field Modelling of Woven-Domain Formation in Ferroelectric Material
summary: A recent experimental study reports the spontaneous formation of a three-dimensional woven ferroelectric domain fabric in bulk KTN:Li during sufficiently slow cooling through the ferroelectric transition. The present work develops a nondimensional phase-field framework to examine a physically plausible route by which such a state can emerge. A large-area two-dimensional model first resolves the cooling-rate-dependent formation of a frustrated crossing precursor by combining first-order ferroelectric thermodynamics, electrostatic and elastic interactions, compositional modulation, and effective charge screening. Slow cooling produces a persistent population of charge-associated crossings, whereas the corresponding fast-cooling pathway does not. A three-dimensional extension then incorporates cubic gradient anisotropy, flexoelectric coupling, and strain-gradient regularization to examine whether the planar precursor can develop a genuine woven topology. Within the explored nondimensional parameter regime, slow cooling produces a directly resolved geometrical separation and exchange of depth ordering between the intersecting wall families, whereas the corresponding fast-cooling pathway does not. This distinction is reproduced across independent realisations and remains robust to timestep refinement and changes in computational domain size. The simulations suggest that slow cooling provides a kinetic window for topological selection and that global charge relaxation can coexist with strong local charge concentration at surviving crossings. The model is not calibrated to material-specific KTN:Li coefficients and does not reproduce the experimentally observed low-temperature disappearance of the woven state.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个无量纲相场框架，研究块体KTN:Li在缓慢冷却过程中自发形成三维编织铁电畴结构的物理机制。通过二维模型解析了冷却速率依赖的受挫交叉前驱体形成，三维扩展结合梯度各向异性、挠曲电耦合和应变梯度正则化，证明缓慢冷却可产生畴壁深度排序的真正编织拓扑，而快速冷却则不能。
AI.motivation: 近期实验研究发现块体KTN:Li在缓慢冷却通过铁电相变时能自发形成三维编织铁电畴织物，但这种奇特拓扑结构的形成机制尚不清楚，需要理论模型来验证其物理可行性并揭示其演化路径。
AI.method: 建立无量纲相场框架：1) 二维模型结合一级铁电热力学、静电和弹性相互作用、成分调制及有效电荷屏蔽，解析冷却速率依赖的受挫交叉前驱体；2) 三维扩展引入立方梯度各向异性、挠曲电耦合和应变梯度正则化，检验平面前驱体能否发展为真正的编织拓扑；3) 通过独立重复实验、时间步长细化和计算域大小变化进行鲁棒性验证。
AI.result: 缓慢冷却能产生持续存在的电荷关联交叉群体，快速冷却则不能；在三维扩展中，缓慢冷却实现了交叉壁族之间深度序的几何分离和交换，形成真正的编织结构，而快速冷却不会出现。该结果在独立实现中可复现，对时间步长和计算域大小具有鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 模拟表明缓慢冷却为拓扑选择提供了动力学窗口，全局电荷弛豫可以与存留交叉处的强局域电荷浓度共存。但模型未针对KTN:Li具体系数校准，也未复现实验中低温下编织态消失的现象，仍需进一步改进。

title: Free-Energy Differences from Nonequilibrium Fluctuations in High Dissipation
summary: Equilibrium free-energy differences can be measured from nonequilibrium work fluctuations using fluctuation theorems, such as the Jarzynski equality and the Crooks fluctuation theorem. However, these approaches become statistically inefficient in high-dissipation regimes because their convergence requires trajectories with negative entropy production, events that occur exponentially rarely. Here, we demonstrate that repeated measurements of trajectory fluctuations are sufficient to determine entropy production without relying on such rare events, or to determine a lower bound on it when only partial measurements are available. This information then yields exact estimates of free-energy differences, or rigorous bounds. We validate this approach, named EquiNET, with numerical simulations, including one of biomolecular folding and unfolding, showing that it recovers accurate free-energy estimates even in regimes where conventional approaches fail.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为EquiNET的新方法，通过重复测量轨迹波动来确定熵产生（或部分测量时的下界），从而精确估计自由能差异或给出严格的界。该方法避免了传统涨落定理（如Jarzynski等式和Crooks涨落定理）在高耗散区域因需要指数级稀有的负熵产生轨迹而导致的统计低效问题，并在数值模拟中（包括生物分子折叠/去折叠）验证了其准确性。
AI.motivation: 传统基于涨落定理（Jarzynski等式、Crooks涨落定理）从非平衡功涨落中测量平衡自由能差异的方法，在高耗散区域统计效率低下，因为其收敛需要负熵产生的稀有轨迹，而这些事件以指数级概率罕见地发生。
AI.method: 提出EquiNET方法：通过重复测量轨迹波动来直接确定熵产生（或部分测量时确定其下界），再利用这些信息获得自由能差异的精确估计或严格界限，无需依赖稀有负熵产生事件。
AI.result: 通过数值模拟验证，包括生物分子折叠和去折叠过程，EquiNET即使在高耗散区域（传统方法失效的区域）也能恢复准确的自甴能估计。
AI.conclusion: EquiNET为在高耗散、非平衡条件下测量自由能差异提供了一种替代传统涨落定理的鲁棒方法，在传统方法失效的场景中仍能给出准确结果或严格的界限。

title: A DQMC study of the spectral and conductive properties of the two-dimensional Holstein model
summary: We study the dynamical properties of the two-dimensional square lattice Holstein Hamiltonian using numerically exact determinant quantum Monte Carlo simulations. In particular, we report systematic calculations of the model's single-particle spectral function and optical conductivity over a range of phonon energies, electron-phonon coupling strengths, carrier concentrations, and temperatures. In doing so, we map the evolution of the system from a dressed metallic phase to a (bi)polaron liquid/insulator to a charge-density-wave insulator as the carrier concentration is tuned from dilute values to half-filling. We corroborate these results using several equal-time correlation measurements and related proxy quantities reconstructed from time-displaced correlation measurements. This paper is also accompanied by an extensive open data set, covering over 16,640 unique parameter values.

AI.tldr: 本文使用行列式量子蒙特卡洛模拟系统研究了二维方格子Holstein模型的动力学性质，报告了单粒子谱函数和光学电导率在多种声子能量、电子-声子耦合强度、载流子浓度和温度下的系统计算结果。通过调节载流子浓度从稀释到半填充，描绘了系统从金属态到(双)极化子液体/绝缘体再到电荷密度波绝缘体的演化过程，并附带超过16,640个参数值的开放数据集。
AI.motivation: 理解电子-声子相互作用驱动的量子多体系统中，载流子浓度如何影响系统的基态相变（金属-极化子-电荷密度波绝缘体），以及这些相变的动力学特征。
AI.method: 使用数值精确的行列式量子蒙特卡洛（determinant QMC）模拟方法，计算单粒子谱函数和光学电导率，并辅以等时关联测量和由时间位移关联重建的代理量进行验证。
AI.result: 系统性地绘制了从稀释浓度到半填充浓度下，系统从修饰金属相→(双)极化子液体/绝缘体→电荷密度波绝缘体的相图演化，并通过多种关联测量相互佐证。
AI.conclusion: 载流子浓度是调控Holstein模型基态和动力学性质的关键参数，研究提供了全面的相图映射和开放数据集，为后续研究提供了坚实基础。

title: Signatures of localization on the edge of a fractional topological insulator
summary: Recent experiments in van der Waals moiré materials have reported realizations of two-dimensional fractional topological insulators (FTIs). We study transport properties of FTI edges at filling factors $ν_{\text{FTI}} = 2(1\pm 1/n)$ with integer $n \geq 2$ (even or odd), each of which supports four counter-propagating edge modes. The edge modes can undergo partial localization, leaving two of the four edge modes conducting. We identify three distinct partial-localization channels and, for each channel, determine the reduced theory describing the remaining conducting modes, from which we obtain the minimal quasiparticle charge. We further explore transport properties of each partially localized phase and in particular determine the corresponding edge conductances. We demonstrate that measurements of the conductance together with the minimal quasiparticle charge provide a fingerprint that uniquely distinguishes the three partially localized phases.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了范德华莫尔材料中分数拓扑绝缘体（FTI）边缘的输运性质，针对填充因子ν_FTI = 2(1±1/n)的系统，该系统支持四条反向传播的边缘模式。研究发现这些边缘模式可发生部分局域化，留下两条导电模式，并识别出三种不同的部分局域化通道，每种通道对应不同的约化理论和最小准粒子电荷。通过测量电导和最小准粒子电荷，可以唯一地区分三种部分局域化相。
AI.motivation: 范德华莫尔材料最近实验报道实现了二维分数拓扑绝缘体（FTI），但这些FTI边缘的输运性质尚未被充分理解。理解边缘模式的输运行为对于实验表征和识别不同的拓扑相至关重要。
AI.method: 作者针对填充因子ν_FTI = 2(1±1/n)（整数n≥2）的FTI边缘，研究其四条反向传播边缘模式的输运性质。识别三种不同的部分局域化通道，通过分析各通道的约化理论推导剩余导电模式的描述，并计算最小准粒子电荷和边缘电导。
AI.result: 确定了三种不同的部分局域化通道，对于每种通道获得了描述剩余导电模式的约化理论及其最小准粒子电荷。计算了每种部分局域化相的边缘电导，并证明电导测量与最小准粒子电荷的组合可作为指纹唯一区分三种部分局域化相。
AI.conclusion: 电导与最小准粒子电荷的联合测量能够唯一区分三种部分局域化相，为实验上表征FTI边缘的输运性质提供了明确的预言和判别标准。

title: Real-Time Density--Source Mapping for Open Electron--Photon Systems
summary: Real-time quantum-electrodynamical density-functional theory (QEDFT) for an open device requires local electron and field histories to determine their sources. For occupation-dependent interactions and a gapped finite-band photon continuum, we prove a causal one-to-one map on the forward image over a nonzero time interval. Three source-reconstruction benchmarks test the electronic limit, the photon-continuum limit, and a coupled joint inverse against a closed-form continuum endpoint. This provides the density--source foundation for real-time open-system QEDFT.

AI.tldr: 本文为实时开放系统量子电动力学密度泛函理论（QEDFT）建立了密度-源的因果一对一映射基础，在有限带隙光子连续谱和占据依赖相互作用条件下证明了可逆性，并通过三个基准测试验证了源重构方法。
AI.motivation: 实时QEDFT用于开放器件时需要从局部电子和场的历史确定其源，但这一因果可逆性映射此前缺乏严格的理论证明，限制了开放系统QEDFT的理论基础。
AI.method: 针对占据依赖相互作用和有间隙有限带光子连续谱，证明了在前向像空间上非零时间间隔内存在因果的一对一映射；并设计了三个源重构基准测试，分别考察电子极限、光子连续极限以及耦合联合逆问题，并与闭式连续端点进行对比。
AI.result: 三个基准测试分别验证了电子极限、光子连续极限和耦合联合逆问题，且与闭式连续端点的比较证实了源重构方法的有效性，确立了开放系统实时QEDFT的密度-源理论基石。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为开放系统实时QEDFT提供了严格的理论基础，确立了密度-源映射的因果可逆性，为后续发展实际开放QEDFT数值方法铺平了道路。

title: First-Principles Atomistic Structure and Dynamics of Polyethylene During High-Pressure Radical Polymerization via Machine Learning Force Fields
summary: Polyethylene (PE) is one of the most commonly used synthetic polymers. While the synthesis and processing protocols for PE are well established, precise experimental assignment of microscopic structures at atomistic resolution (i.e., the position of each atom) remains largely limited to highly crystalline systems. This gap is often addressed via computer simulations using empirical interatomic potentials, which use approximate but efficient descriptions of interatomic interactions to reach the length and time scales needed to describe macromolecules. These empirical potentials typically perform well for bulk and/or collective properties but face challenges with chemical realism for complex systems, e.g., during reactive processes. In this work, we address this challenge by combining the computational efficiency of a deep potential (DP) machine-learning force field and the chemical realism of first-principles van der Waals (vdW) corrected hybrid density functional theory (DFT) enabled by a SeA high-throughput framework. Using this approach, we study the structure and dynamics of PE oligomers and polymers in an ethylene solvent under common high-pressure (supercritical) radical polymerization conditions. We found that the local solvation environment of radical-containing PE oligomers converges for chain lengths greater than (n~6), suggesting extensibility of our oligomer-trained MLFF to significantly longer polymers. We then confirmed the extensibility of these models to long PE chains by characterizing the molecular weight scaling of single-chain structure and dynamics, which showed classic good solvent behavior. Our PE MLFF retained a consistent level of fidelity and stability across a wide range of thermodynamic state points and chain lengths, at full atomistic resolution, therefore paving the way towards first-principles-based polymer structure and property prediction.

AI.tldr: 本文通过结合深度势（DP）机器学习力场与基于混合泛函的第一性原理范德华修正密度泛函理论，开发了聚乙烯（PE）的原子级精确力场，并在超临界乙烯溶剂条件下成功模拟了PE低聚物和聚合物的结构与动力学，验证了模型可外推到长链聚合物，为基于第一性原理的聚合物结构预测开辟了新途径。
AI.motivation: 聚乙烯是常用的合成聚合物，但其微观原子级结构的精确实验表征仅限于高度结晶体系。传统经验势能函数在描述复杂体系的化学反应过程时化学真实性不足，因此需要一种既高效又具备化学物理真实性的方法来实现PE结构的原子级精确模拟。
AI.method: 将深度势（DP）机器学习力场的计算效率与第一性原理范德华修正混合密度泛函理论（DFT）的化学真实性相结合，通过SeA高通量框架构建PE机器学习力场，并在高压（超临界）自由基聚合条件下对乙烯溶剂中的PE低聚物和聚合物进行结构及动力学模拟。
AI.result: 研究发现含自由基PE低聚物的局域溶剂化环境在链长大于约6时收敛，表明从低聚物训练的力场可外推至更长聚合物；通过单链结构分子量标度行为确认了模型对长链PE的可扩展性，展现出经典良溶剂行为；该力场在广泛热力学状态点和链长范围内保持一致的保真度和稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 所构建的PE机器学习力场在原子级分辨率下表现出稳定的高保真度，能够跨越多种热力学条件和链长进行可靠模拟，为基于第一性原理的聚合物结构和性能预测奠定了基础。

title: Cramer-Rao Inequality Generalizes the Equilibrium Energy Fluctuation-Response Relation to Nonequilibrium Steady States
summary: Equilibrium steady states are fully characterized by the Boltzmann distribution, which depends only on the energy and the temperature. In contrast, nonequilibrium steady states, which describe a wide range of physical and biological phenomena, are generically much more complex, and their stationary distributions can depend on a zoo of kinetic parameters. A central challenge of nonequilibrium statistical mechanics is the identification of universal relations that hold for nonequilibrium steady states despite this complexity. We show here that a form of the Cramer-Rao inequality applies to arbitrary nonequilibrium steady-state distributions and contains no explicit dependence on kinetic parameters. A main original feature in our observation is that this inequality becomes a well-known fluctuation-response relation in equilibrium. The inequality involves three well-defined quantities: the fluctuations of the energy, the response given by the derivative of the average energy with respect to the inverse temperature, and the Fisher information with respect to the inverse temperature. We illustrate this inequality using three representative models: an active particle in a harmonic potential, a simple scheme for kinetic proofreading, and a one-dimensional model for heat conduction between two baths.

AI.tldr: 本文发现Cramér-Rao不等式适用于任意非平衡稳态分布，且不含显式的动力学参数依赖。该不等式在平衡态下退化为众所周知的涨落-响应关系，涉及能量涨落、能量对逆温度的响应对及Fisher信息三个量，并通过三个代表性模型（谐振子势中的活性粒子、动力学校对方案、一维热传导模型）进行验证。
AI.motivation: 非平衡稳态的平稳分布通常依赖于大量动力学参数，远比平衡态复杂（仅由能量和温度决定）。寻找不依赖这些动力学参数的普适关系是非平衡统计力学的核心挑战，本文旨在发现这样的普适不等式。
AI.method: 作者证明Cramér-Rao不等式的一种形式适用于任意非平衡稳态分布，该不等式不显式依赖动力学参数。不等式包含三个量：能量涨落、平均能量对逆温度的导数（响应项）以及关于逆温度的Fisher信息。作者用三个代表性模型（活性粒子、动力学校对、热传导）加以验证。
AI.result: 建立了适用于任意非平衡稳态分布的Cramér-Rao型不等式，该不等式不含动力学参数，且在平衡态下退化为经典的涨落-响应关系。三个模型均验证了该不等式的成立。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为非平衡统计力学提供了一个普适性的不等式关系，架起了非平衡稳态与经典涨落-响应理论之间的桥梁，有望为理解非平衡系统中的能量涨落与响应提供新的理论工具。

title: Interaction-mediated Co-existence of Altermagnetism and Topology
summary: We study an extended Hubbard model on Lieb lattice at electron filling 2 and 4, and demonstrate that the interactions lead to the simultaneous emergence of altermagnetic order and a topological gap. Using unrestricted Hartree-Fock theory, we evaluate both the altermagnetic and topological order parameters and show that they co-exist with an associated quantum spin Hall effect in a large region of the phase diagram, which we further support using exact diagonalization. Moreover, we demonstrate that inversion-symmetry breaking terms can also mediate second-order topological phases with associated corner modes.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了Lieb晶格上扩展Hubbard模型在电子填充2和4时的性质，证明相互作用导致交变磁序和拓扑能隙同时出现。通过无约束Hartree-Fock理论计算交变磁和拓扑序参量，发现它们在相图的大区域内共存并伴随量子自旋霍尔效应，进一步用精确对角化验证。此外还证明反演对称性破缺项可介导伴随角态的二阶拓扑相。
AI.motivation: 探索交变磁（altermagnetism）与拓扑能隙之间的共存关系，特别是在Lieb晶格这一几何阻挫晶格上，研究相互作用驱动的拓扑磁性相及其与量子自旋霍尔效应的关联。
AI.method: 使用无约束Hartree-Fock理论（unrestricted Hartree-Fock theory）计算交变磁和拓扑序参量，并用精确对角化（exact diagonalization）进行验证。研究的模型为Lieb晶格上的扩展Hubbard模型，关注填充数2和4的情况。
AI.result: 在相图的大区域内，交变磁序和拓扑能隙同时出现，并伴随量子自旋霍尔效应。此外，反演对称性破缺可以导致二阶拓扑相的出现，伴随有角态（corner modes）。
AI.conclusion: Lieb晶格上的相互作用可以同时驱动交变磁序和拓扑能隙，二者共存并伴随量子自旋霍尔效应；反演对称性破缺还能产生二阶拓扑相和角态，丰富了该体系中的拓扑磁性物理。

title: Parity-dependent coupling of molecular spin chains to a superconductor
summary: Topological order can fractionalize the quantum numbers of the underlying particles. A paradigmatic example is the spin-1/2 states at the edges of an antiferromagnetic integer-spin chain, protected by a topological Haldane gap in the bulk and mutually coupled in short chains. Owing to their topological protection, they are natural building blocks for hybrid spin-superconductor quantum systems. Whether fractionalization survives the coupling to a superconducting condensate, however, remains an open question. Here we grow molecular Haldane chains of antiferromagnetically coupled spin-1 triangulene units on a proximitized Au(111)/Nb(110) surface and resolve a parity-dependent coupling of their spin-1/2 edge states to the superconducting condensate by scanning tunnelling spectroscopy. Odd-length chains host Yu-Shiba-Rusinov bound states inside the superconducting gap, originating from the net S=1 ground state, whereas even-length chains form an S=0 ground state decoupled from the superconductor. A two-site superconductor model reveals that this alternation arises from the sign and strength of the inter-edge interaction, a mechanism independently validated by extra-gap spin excitations in tunnelling spectra. Collective many-body spin excitation modes are also detected decoupled from the superconductor by the much larger Haldane gap. The length-tunable coupling of the edge spins to the superconductor opens a route toward molecular spin qubits based on $π$-conjugated carbon architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分子Haldane链（反铁磁耦合的自旋-1 triangulene单元）在近邻化Au(111)/Nb(110)表面上的生长，利用扫描隧道谱研究了自旋-1/2边缘态与超导凝聚体的耦合。研究发现奇长链因S=1基态在超导能隙内产生Yu-Shiba-Rusinov束缚态，而偶长链形成S=0基态与超导体解耦，揭示了一种长度可调的边缘自旋-超导耦合机制。
AI.motivation: 拓扑序可以将底层粒子的量子数分数化，自旋-1/2边缘态受拓扑Haldane能隙保护，是构建混合自旋-超导量子系统的天然构件。然而分数化能否在超导凝聚体耦合下存活仍是开放问题，需要实验验证。
AI.method: 在近邻化Au(111)/Nb(110)表面上生长分子Haldane链（反铁磁耦合的自旋-1 triangulene单元），利用扫描隧道谱（STS）分辨不同长度链中自旋-1/2边缘态与超导凝聚体的奇偶依赖耦合，并结合两站点超导体模型进行分析验证。
AI.result: 奇长链产生净S=1基态，在超导能隙内宿主Yu-Shiba-Rusinov束缚态；偶长链形成S=0基态，与超导体完全解耦。两站点模型揭示这种交替源于边缘间相互作用的符号和强度，并通过能隙外自旋激发得到独立验证。还检测到由更大的Haldane能隙保护、与超导体解耦的集体多体自旋激发模式。
AI.conclusion: 边缘自旋与超导体的耦合可通过链长调控，为基于π共轭碳架构的分子自旋量子比特开辟了新途径。

title: Tracking molecular hydrogen formation from ionized water in real time
summary: Removing an electron from a water molecule can drive its two hydrogen atoms to pair up and depart as molecular hydrogen. However, even for this elementary reaction, the route from start to finish has remained hidden because measurements have yet to follow the electronic and nuclear motion simultaneously. Combining correlated photoelectron and ion imaging, few-femtosecond pump--probe measurements, and nonadiabatic simulations, we track the complete pathway in isolated heavy water (D$_2$O) molecules. The reaction takes an indirect route and dissociates along three distinct pathways (direct, roaming, and delayed) with formation times of about 34 and 72 femtoseconds for the direct and delayed branches. Yet bond formation requires the molecule to first break its own symmetry. Only random asymmetric motion enables the electronic-state switch at a conical intersection, joining the two hydrogen atoms before the oxygen--hydrogen bond breaks. These results establish a time-resolved picture of molecular hydrogen formation from water and provide a general strategy for linking electronic excitation to chemical outcomes in settings from radiation damage to hydrogen production.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过结合相关光电子与离子成像、几飞秒泵浦-探测测量和非绝热模拟，在孤立重水分子中完整追踪了电子激发驱动氢原子配对形成分子氢的全过程。反应沿直接、漫游和延迟三条途径解离，形成时间约为34飞秒（直接分支）和72飞秒（延迟分支），且键合形成需要分子先打破自身对称性，只有随机的不对称运动才能使电子态在圆锥交叉处发生切换。
AI.motivation: 尽管从水分子的一个氢原子上移除电子后，两个氢原子会配对并以分子氢形式离开，这是最基础的反应之一，但该反应从起始到终点的完整路径一直未被揭示，因为先前的测量无法同时追踪电子运动和核运动。
AI.method: 采用相关光电子与离子成像技术、几飞秒级的泵浦-探测测量方法，并结合非绝热模拟，在孤立重水分子（D2O）中追踪反应的完整路径。
AI.result: 反应通过间接路径进行，沿直接、漫游和延迟三条不同途径解离，直接和延迟分支的形成时间分别约为34飞秒和72飞秒。研究发现键的形成要求分子首先打破自身对称性，只有随机的非对称运动才能使电子态在圆锥交叉处发生切换，进而在氧-氢键断裂前将两个氢原子连接起来。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果建立了水分子中分子氢形成的时间分辨图景，并为将电子激发与化学结果联系起来提供了普适策略，可应用于辐射损伤到氢气生产等众多领域。

title: Thermodynamic and Kinetic Tests for Low-Pressure Metal-Flux Growth of Diamond, with an Extension to Cubic Boron Nitride
comment: 51 pages, including 34 pages of Supporting Information; 6 main-text figures. Perspective
summary: Diamond was grown from a liquid Ga-Fe-Ni-Si alloy near 1 atm, although bulk graphite is thermodynamically more stable under those conditions. This Perspective asks what must be true for a diamond growth front to continue advancing in such a metastable regime. I define a finite-difference transfer free energy for a specified interfacial event and identify the completed attachment of one carbon atom at a kink as the repeatable event that governs sustained growth. In the macroscopic limit, surface terms cancel, and the required carbon activity is fixed by the bulk free energy of diamond. On a graphite-normalized scale, the diamond equilibrium threshold is about 2.0 at 1300 K, whereas graphite saturation occurs at unity. Diamond growth therefore requires kinetic selection above the graphite threshold, not a reversal of bulk phase stability. The analysis distinguishes thermodynamic driving force, kinetic accessibility, experimental detection limits, and the carbon retained after an experiment. It gives isotope-resolved tests for distinguishing sustained diamond growth from seed survival, transient carbon attachment, or failure to detect graphite. A $^{13}\mathrm{C}$-enriched diamond seed provides a test of natural-abundance gas or condensed carbon sources: a registered, crystallographically continuous $^{12}\mathrm{C}$-rich layer outside the original seed can establish source-attributed overgrowth without isotopically labeling each feed. The same accounting is extended to cubic boron nitride. Separate boron and nitrogen chemical potentials are required, and $^{10}\mathrm{B}/^{11}\mathrm{B}$ and $^{15}\mathrm{N}$ contrasts could distinguish reservoir supply from seed loss for each element. The resulting criteria make low-pressure metal-flux growth claims quantitatively testable and guide experiments, thermodynamic modeling, and atomistic simulation.

AI.tldr: 本文从热力学与动力学角度分析了在亚稳态条件下（近1 atm液态Ga-Fe-Ni-Si合金中）金刚石持续生长的可能性，提出以碳原子在台阶边缘的完整附着作为可重复事件，定义了有限差分转移自由能，并给出了区分持续生长与种子存活、瞬态附着及石墨未检出的同位素分辨实验判据，同时将该分析方法推广至立方氮化硼。
AI.motivation: 尽管在热力学上体相石墨在1 atm下更稳定，但实验观察到了金刚石在液态合金中的生长。作者旨在回答：在这种亚稳条件下，金刚石生长前沿如何能够持续推进？这一问题的回答需要对热力学驱动力与动力学可达性进行严格区分，从而为低压金属熔剂生长金刚石的主张提供定量可检验的标准。
AI.method: 作者定义了一个针对特定界面事件的有限差分转移自由能，将以台阶（kink）处一个碳原子的完整附着作为决定持续生长的可重复事件。在宏观极限下，表面项相互抵消，所需碳活度由金刚石的体相自由能决定。在石墨归一化尺度上，1300 K下金刚石平衡阈值约为2.0，而石墨饱和度为1。作者进一步将热力学驱动力、动力学可达性、实验检测限及实验后残留碳进行区分，并设计了同位素分辨实验（13C富集种子、12C富集外层）来区分持续生长与种子存活、瞬态附着或石墨未检出，并将该核算方法推广到cBN，需要分别考虑硼和氮的化学势，并利用10B/11B和15N对比度区分储库供给与种子损失。
AI.result: 分析表明，金刚石在亚稳区间的生长需要的是石墨阈值以上的动力学选择性，而非体相稳定性的反转。文章给出了同位素分辨的判据：13C富集的金刚石种子可检验天然气或凝聚碳源——在原始种子外登记到晶体学连续的12C富集层可建立源归属的过生长证据，而无需逐一标记每种原料。该核算方法同样适用于cBN，给出了硼和氮各自的化学势要求及同位素对比度方案。由此产生的判据使低压金属熔剂生长主张具有定量可检验性。
AI.conclusion: 作者的框架为亚稳态金刚石（及cBN）生长提供了严格的定量判据，明确了动力学选择而非热力学稳定性是持续生长的关键，并通过同位素分辨实验设计使实验验证成为可能，可指导未来的实验、热力学建模和原子尺度模拟。

title: First-Principles Spin-Lattice Coupling from Downfolded Electron-Phonon Interaction
summary: We present a method to calculate spin-phonon coupling parameters from first-principles perturbation theory by downfolding the electron-phonon coupling (EPC). We exploit the localized nature of magnetic moments and atomic displacements by working in the Wannier representation of the electronic Hamiltonian and the EPC matrix. The spin system is mapped to a classical Heisenberg Hamiltonian, whose parameters are obtained by treating local spin rotations as a perturbation within a Green's-function formalism. The spin and phonon perturbations are connected through the EPC parameters, which enter as lattice-induced perturbations to the tight-binding Hamiltonian. By combining these lattice perturbations with local spin rotations, we obtain real-space derivatives of magnetic exchange parameters without performing displaced magnetic supercell calculations. We illustrate the method on SrMnO$_3$ and show that it can be integrated directly into standard workflows.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种从第一性原理微扰论计算自旋-声子耦合参数的方法，通过Wannier表示中的电子-声子耦合矩阵下折叠，结合Green函数形式将自旋旋转作为微扰，无需位移磁超胞计算即可获得磁交换参数在实空间中的导数。
AI.motivation: 自旋-声子耦合对理解磁性材料的热力学性质、磁振子衰减和拓扑磁现象至关重要，但传统方法需要通过位移磁超胞计算，计算成本高且流程繁琐。
AI.method: 利用磁矩和原子位移的局域性，在Wannier表示中表示电子哈密顿量和EPC矩阵。自旋系统映射为经典Heisenberg哈密顿量，通过Green函数形式将局域自旋旋转作为微扰处理。自旋和声子微扰通过EPC参数连接，作为晶格诱导微扰进入紧束缚哈密顿量。将晶格微扰与局域自旋旋转结合，获得磁交换参数在实空间的导数。
AI.result: 在SrMnO3上进行了方法演示，证明了该方法可以无缝集成到标准工作流程中，且无需进行位移磁超胞计算。
AI.conclusion: 该方法提供了一种高效、直接的第一性原理途径来计算自旋-声子耦合参数，避免了传统位移超胞计算的复杂性，可广泛适用于磁性材料研究。

title: Run-and-tumble particles with preferred reorientation
summary: Run-and-tumble particles (RTPs) are canonically modeled with uniform reorientation probabilities, an assumption that breaks down for many biological microswimmers. In this work, we investigate the dynamics of RTPs with arbitrary non-uniform tumble distributions. By deriving an exact Doi-Peliti field theory, we explicitly calculate a wide array of spatial and orientational observables. Notably, we demonstrate that the spatial dynamics exhibit an effective persistence and chirality governed entirely by the first Fourier modes of the tumble distribution, establishing a formal mapping to the dynamics of chiral active Brownian particles. Furthermore, our field-theoretic framework provides a systematic method to compute spatial moments to arbitrary order, allowing for the complete characterization and identification of complex tumbling dynamics. We illustrate the framework with wrapped Gaussian and bimodal Gaussian distributions, demonstrating explicit control over persistence and chirality. We further extend the field theory to $d$ dimensions, recovering the mean squared displacement in terms of a single effective tumble rate. Our results establish a direct link between the shape of the tumble distribution and the emergent dynamics, and provide a foundation for the study of interacting RTPs with non-uniform reorientation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了具有任意非均匀翻转分布的游走-翻滚粒子（RTPs）动力学，通过推导精确的Doi-Peliti场论，显式计算了多种空间和取向可观测量。研究发现空间动力学表现出完全由翻转分布第一傅里叶模式决定的有效持久性和手性，建立了与手性活性布朗粒子动力学的形式映射，并将场论框架推广到d维空间。
AI.motivation: 传统RTP模型假设均匀重定向概率，但这一假设对许多生物微游泳者不成立。因此需要开发一个能够处理任意非均匀翻转分布的通用理论框架，以理解翻转分布形状如何影响粒子的涌现动力学行为。
AI.method: 作者推导了精确的Doi-Peliti场论框架来处理具有任意非均匀翻转分布的RTPs。通过这一场论框架，显式计算各种空间和取向可观测量，系统性地计算任意阶空间矩，并将理论扩展到d维空间。
AI.result: 证明空间动力学由翻转分布的第一傅里叶模式完全控制，表现为有效持久性和手性；建立了与手性活性布朗粒子的形式映射；用包裹高斯和双峰高斯分布验证了框架的有效性；在d维空间中恢复了用单一有效翻转率表示的均方位移。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了翻转分布形状与涌现动力学之间的直接联系，为研究具有非均匀重定向的相互作用RTPs奠定了基础。

title: Momentum-resolved EELS study of collective charge excitations in 1$T$-TaS$_2$
summary: We use momentum-resolved electron energy-loss spectroscopy (M-EELS) to study the low-energy charge excitations of 1$T$-TaS$_2$ across the nearly commensurate-to-commensurate charge-density-wave (CDW) transition. Single-crystal x-ray diffraction and elastic M-EELS measurements confirm the expected rotation of the CDW wave vector upon entering the commensurate phase. In the nearly commensurate phase, the low-energy M-EELS spectra reveal an acoustic phonon branch and two optical phonon features whose energies and dispersions are broadly consistent with previous calculations and inelastic x-ray measurements. Across the transition, the optical phonon energies remain nearly unchanged, while their spectral intensity develops a pronounced temperature dependence near the CDW ordering wave vector. At higher energies, the finite-momentum charge response undergoes a substantial redistribution of spectral weight below the transition, consistent with the opening of an energy gap. These results demonstrate that M-EELS provides simultaneous access to lattice dynamics and finite-momentum valence band charge excitations in 1$T$-TaS$_2$, revealing their evolution across the commensurate CDW transition.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用动量分辨电子能量损失谱（M-EELS）研究了1T-TaS₂在近公度到公度电荷密度波（CDW）相变过程中的低能电荷激发。研究发现声学声子支和两个光学声子特征与理论计算及非弹性X射线测量一致；相变过程中光学声子能量基本不变，但谱强度在CDW有序波矢附近表现出显著的温度依赖性；更高能处观察到有限动量电荷响应的谱权重重分布，与能隙开启一致。
AI.motivation: 理解1T-TaS₂中CDW相变的微观机制，特别是低能电荷激发（包括声子和价带电荷激发）在该相变中的演化行为，从而揭示CDW形成与转变的物理本质。
AI.method: 采用动量分辨电子能量损失谱（M-EELS）测量低能电荷激发，并结合单晶X射线衍射和弹性M-EELS确认CDW波矢在进入公度相时的旋转。通过比较近公度相和公度相的光学声子能量、谱强度及高能电荷响应来追踪相变过程中的变化。
AI.result: （1）近公度相中观测到声学声子支和两个光学声子特征，其能量和色散与计算及非弹性X射线测量一致；（2）相变时光学声子能量几乎不变，但谱强度在CDW波矢附近呈现显著温度依赖；（3）更高能处有限动量电荷响应在相变下方发生谱权重大幅重分布，与能隙开启一致。
AI.conclusion: M-EELS能够同时探测1T-TaS₂中的晶格动力学和有限动量价带电荷激发，揭示了它们在公度CDW相变过程中的演化，展示了该技术在研究强关联体系中电荷有序现象方面的独特优势。

title: Antidot superlattices in two-dimensional topological insulators
summary: We investigate the electronic properties of a two-dimensional topological insulator patterned with an array of circular holes. The band structures of the topological insulator superlattices are calculated using the Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang model, discretized with the finite element method. The band topology is studied using the Fukui-Hatsugai-Suzuki method, exploiting the fact that topological charge is conserved when a band gap closes and reopens. We find that when the holes are close to each other and the edge states overlap significantly, the material loses its topological character and becomes a trivial insulator. The results show that patterning topological insulators changes their properties, and this can be achieved with a feature size compatible with current lithographic techniques. This shows the potential to incorporate patterned topological insulators in future electronics.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用BHZ模型和有限元方法，计算了带有周期性圆形孔洞图案的二维拓扑绝缘体的电子结构和能带拓扑。研究发现当孔洞距离很近、边缘态显著重叠时，材料会失去拓扑特性变为平凡绝缘体，为未来电子产品中集成图案化拓扑绝缘体提供了可能。
AI.motivation: 探索如何通过图案化（在二维拓扑绝缘体上打圆形孔洞阵列）来调控材料的拓扑性质，以期为未来电子器件集成提供新途径。
AI.method: 采用Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang（BHZ）模型描述拓扑绝缘体，用有限元方法离散化计算超晶格的能带结构；利用Fukui-Hatsugai-Suzuki方法研究能带拓扑，通过能带闭合与重新打开的拓扑荷守恒原理分析拓扑相变。
AI.result: 当孔洞彼此靠近导致边缘态显著重叠时，材料失去拓扑特性，从拓扑绝缘体转变为平凡绝缘体。图案化拓扑绝缘体的特征尺寸与当前光刻技术兼容。
AI.conclusion: 图案化拓扑绝缘体能够改变其电子性质，这种技术具备与现有光刻工艺兼容的尺寸，展示了在电子器件中集成图案化拓扑绝缘体的潜力。

title: Environmental Control Extends Beyond Quantum Dephasing in Exciton Energy Transfer
summary: Excitation-energy transfer underpins the conversion of light into usable energy in photosynthetic organisms and serves as a paradigm for evolutionary optimized transport in open quantum systems. Although this process is often described as incoherent thermally assisted hopping, such descriptions become inadequate when electronic coupling, vibronic interactions and environmental fluctuations occur on comparable energy scales. Determining how the environment controls transport therefore remains a fundamental challenge. Here, we use temperature-dependent 2DES to investigate energy transfer in the photosynthetic antenna protein allophycocyanin over the range 10 - 296 K. The dominant $β\rightarrow α$ transfer step exhibits a pronounced non-monotonic temperature dependence: the transfer time decreases from 400 fs at 10 K to 200 fs near 30- 40 K before increasing again to 400 fs at 296 K. In contrast, the homogeneous optical dephasing time decreases monotonically across the same temperature range. To interpret these observations, we model APC as a vibronically coupled excitonic dimer interacting with a structured environment and solve the dynamics using hierarchical equations of motion. Conventional fixed-bath models, including Drude-Lorentz and explicit intermolecular-mode spectral densities, fail to reproduce the observed turnover. Quantitative agreement is obtained only when the low-frequency sector of the environmental spectral density is allowed to anharmonically evolve strongly with temperature, while the high-frequency bath remains essentially unchanged. More broadly, these findings demonstrate that transport efficiency is controlled not simply by the magnitude of environmental fluctuations, but by the distribution of environmental spectral weight across frequency space, providing new experimental constraints on theories of molecular transport in complex quantum environments.

AI.tldr: 本文利用温度依赖的二维电子光谱（2DES）研究光合天线蛋白别藻蓝蛋白（APC）在10-296 K范围内的能量转移过程，发现β→α转移步骤呈现非单调温度依赖性（转移时间从10 K的400 fs降至30-40 K的200 fs，再回升至296 K的400 fs），而均匀光学退相时间则单调下降。通过将APC建模为振动耦合的激子二聚体并用分级运动方程（HEOM）求解动力学，发现只有允许低频环境谱密度随温度强烈非谐演化才能定量重现实验结果，说明输运效率由环境谱权重的频率分布而非环境涨落幅度决定。
AI.motivation: 光合生物中的激发能量转移是开放量子系统中演化优化的输运范式，但当电子耦合、振动相互作用和环境涨落处于相近能标时，传统的不相干热辅助跳跃描述失效。理解环境如何控制输运仍是根本性挑战，需要实验与理论的深入结合。
AI.method: 采用温度依赖的二维电子光谱（2DES）在10-296 K范围内测量APC蛋白中的能量转移动力学；将APC建模为振动耦合激子二聚体并与结构化环境相互作用，使用分级运动方程（HEOM）求解量子动力学；测试包括Drude-Lorentz和显式分子间振动模式谱密度在内的常规固定浴模型。
AI.result: 发现β→α能量转移时间呈非单调温度依赖（400 fs→200 fs→400 fs），而均匀退相时间单调下降。常规固定浴模型（Drude-Lorentz和显式分子间模式）无法重现观察到的转折现象。只有允许低频环境谱密度随温度强烈非谐演化、同时保持高频浴基本不变时，才能获得定量一致的吻合。
AI.conclusion: 输运效率不仅由环境涨落的幅度决定，更由环境谱权重在频率空间中的分布决定。这一发现为复杂量子环境中的分子输运理论提供了新的实验约束。

title: Dynamic Magnetic Pair-Density Function of a One-Dimensional Ferromagnet
summary: The dynamic magnetic pair-density function (DymPDF) $D_{\rm M}(r, E)$ is derived by extending the static magnetic pair distribution function (mPDF) to finite energy transfer. The analytical DymPDF of a one-dimensional Heisenberg ferromagnet is obtained from the magnon dispersion and compared with simulations performed using {\textsc SpinW}. Excellent agreement is achieved for energy dependence of the nearest-neighbor spin-pair correlation, demonstrating that the DymPDF changes sign at the magnon-mode transition occurring at one-half of the maximum magnon energy. The real-space DymPDF at low energy is also reproduced with a model including finite instrumental resolution, magnetic correlation length, and Fourier-termination effects. These results establish the theoretical foundation of DymPDF analysis for investigating local spin dynamics in magnetic materials.

AI.tldr: 本文通过将静态磁对分布函数(mPDF)扩展到有限能量转移，提出了动态磁对密度函数(DymPDF) D_M(r, E)的概念。利用一维海森堡铁磁体的解析解与SpinW模拟进行对比验证，在最近邻自旋-对关联的能量依赖性上取得高度一致，并发现DymPDF在最大磁振子能量一半处发生符号变化。该工作为研究磁性材料的局域自旋动力学奠定了理论基础。
AI.motivation: 静态mPDF仅能提供材料磁结构的实空间信息，无法捕捉自旋动力学行为（如磁振子激发）。研究者希望通过将mPDF扩展到能量转移维度，建立一种能够同时解析实空间和能量依赖的自旋关联方法，从而为研究磁性材料中的局域自旋动力学提供新的分析工具。
AI.method: 1) 从静态mPDF出发，将其数学形式推广到含能量转移的DymPDF。2) 基于一维海森堡铁磁体的磁振子色散关系推导解析形式的DymPDF。3) 使用SpinW软件进行数值模拟与解析解对比验证。4) 在低能区域引入仪器分辨率、磁关联长度和傅里叶截断效应等修正模型进行模拟复现。
AI.result: 解析DymPDF与SpinW模拟结果在最近邻自旋-对关联的能量依赖性上高度吻合。发现DymPDF在最大磁振子能量的一半处发生符号反转（对应磁振子模式转变点）。低能实空间DymPDF通过包含仪器分辨率和磁关联长度等效应后也能被准确复现。
AI.conclusion: 该研究建立了DymPDF分析的理论基础，证实了DymPDF作为一种能够同时提供实空间结构和能量/动力学信息的新工具的有效性，为未来在磁性材料中研究局域自旋动力学开辟了新途径。

title: Emergent Noncollinearity and Near-Degenerate Magnetic Superlattices in AT6X6 Kagome Metals
summary: Ferromagnetic AT6X6 Kagome compounds are a popular class of systems in which quantum magnetism with topological features has been observed. These systems allow easy chemical substitution, creating an opportunity to fine-tune their properties. In this paper, we present electronic-structure and magnetic ground-state studies of several AT6X6 compounds with relatively low magnetic-ground-state stability. We find unusual magnetic orderings, including complex spin-spiral states and the formation of magnetic long-range superstructures. While LiFe6Ga6 and TiMn6Ge6 retain collinear AFM ground states with low-energy FM/AFM layer sequences, competing spin-spiral and long-period antiferromagnetic structures in MgFe6Ga6 and a double-spin-spiral ground state in TiFe6Ga6 were determined. Magnetism in all these systems appears local, with adiabatic energy profiles suggesting non-Heisenberg long-range interactions, including a strong biquadratic term. In TiMn6Ge6, we found the conditions for magnetic tunneling. Our results show that, in addition to traditional magnetic topological features in such FM Kagome systems, near-degenerate magnetic superstructures suitable for spintronic switching applications can form naturally. Overall, these systems represent a potentially rich playground for neutron diffraction and spintronics experimental studies.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了多种低磁基态稳定性的AT6X6 Kagome铁磁化合物的电子结构和磁性基态，发现复杂自旋螺旋态、磁性长程超结构以及双自旋螺旋基态等非常规磁有序，并揭示非Heisenberg长程相互作用（含强双二次项），为自旋电子学和中子衍射实验提供了丰富的研究平台。
AI.motivation: 铁磁AT6X6 Kagome化合物是展示具有拓扑特征的量子磁性的热门体系，且易于化学取代以微调其性质，因此有必要系统研究低磁基态稳定性化合物的磁性行为，以探索新型磁有序和潜在的自旋电子学应用。
AI.method: 采用电子结构计算和磁性基态研究方法，对多种AT6X6化合物（LiFe6Ga6、TiMn6Ge6、MgFe6Ga6、TiFe6Ga6等）进行磁性基态分析，包括计算自旋螺旋态、磁性超结构以及绝热能量剖面，以探究磁性相互作用性质。
AI.result: 发现LiFe6Ga6和TiMn6Ge6保持共线反铁磁基态（含低能FM/AFM层序），MgFe6Ga6中竞争自旋螺旋与长周期反铁磁结构，TiFe6Ga6呈现双自旋螺旋基态。磁性均为局域性，绝热能量剖面显示非Heisenberg长程相互作用（含强双二次项）。TiMn6Ge6中发现了磁隧穿条件。
AI.conclusion: 除了传统Kagome FM体系中的磁拓扑特征外，这些体系可自然形成近简并的磁性超结构，适合自旋开关应用，为中子衍射和自旋电子学实验研究提供了丰富的平台。

title: Non-Abelian Spin Counting of Ordered Stochastic Trajectories: Reentrant Finite-Time Chern Numbers
summary: Conventional full counting statistics assigns commuting phases to integrated stochastic currents and therefore resolves net transport but not, in general, the temporal ordering of events associated with different cycles. We introduce a non-Abelian counting construction in which crossings of two fundamental cycles rotate an auxiliary spin about different axes. The resulting ordered trajectory statistic has an exact finite-dimensional evolution equation for its first moment. The two rotation angles form a counting torus, and whenever the mean spin is nonzero its normalized direction defines a map $\mathbb T^2\to\mathbb S^2$, equivalently a complex eigenline bundle with a Chern number. Our main analytical result is a Chern--parity correspondence. Reflection symmetry equips this eigenline with a real structure and expresses $C_T\bmod2$ through first Stiefel--Whitney classes on the circles fixed by reflection. When the transverse polarization has no additional zeros along the reflection-fixed circles, these classes reduce to ordinary current-parity statistics at the four high-symmetry counting points. For a five-state nonequilibrium figure-eight network, varying only the observation time produces four polarization-gap closings and the reentrant sequence $C_T=0\to-1\to0\to-1\to0$. Every transition occurs at $(π,π)$ and coincides with a sign reversal of $\mathbb E[(-1)^{Q_1+Q_2}]$, while the full integer Chern number is obtained independently from the two-dimensional spin texture. Finite observation time can therefore organize a fixed stochastic process into distinct topological sectors of its ordered path ensemble.

AI.tldr: 本文引入了一种非阿贝尔计数构造，通过让两个基本环路的穿越旋转辅助自旋来解析随机过程中事件的时序顺序，并建立了Chern数-宇称对应关系，展示了有限观测时间可将固定随机过程组织成不同的拓扑扇区。
AI.motivation: 传统的全计数统计只能为集成的随机流赋予交换的相位，解决净输运问题，但无法解析不同环路相关事件的时间顺序。作者旨在克服这一局限性，提出一种能捕捉事件时序的非阿贝尔计数框架。
AI.method: 引入非阿贝尔计数构造，两个基本环路穿越时使辅助自旋绕不同轴旋转；得到的有序轨迹统计量的一阶矩具有精确的有限维演化方程；两个旋转角构成计数环面T^2，平均自旋非零时其归一化方向定义映射T^2→S^2，等价于具有Chern数的复特征线丛；通过反射对称性赋予特征线实结构，将C_T mod 2通过第一Stiefel-Whitney类表达。
AI.result: 建立了Chern宇称对应关系：反射对称性将C_T mod 2与反射固定圆上的第一Stiefel-Whitney类联系起来。在五态非平衡八字形网络中，仅改变观测时间就产生四次极化能隙闭合和序列C_T=0→-1→0→-1→0。每个转变都发生在(π,π)处，并与E[(-1)^{Q1+Q2}]的符号反转一致。
AI.conclusion: 有限观测时间可以将固定的随机过程组织成其有序路径系综中不同的拓扑扇区，为研究随机过程中的时序结构提供了新的拓扑工具。

title: Flux-induced Aharonov-Bohm Oscillation in the Tunneling Spectroscopy of Kitaev Spin Liquids
summary: Identifying emergent flux excitations and signatures of their mutual statistics with itinerant Majorana fermions remains a central challenge in Kitaev spin liquids. We show that an isolated $π$ flux imprints an intrinsic Aharonov-Bohm-like interference pattern on the charge-neutral Majorana continuum. Spatially resolved scanning tunneling microscopy with inelastic electron tunneling spectroscopy (STM-IETS) probes this oscillation in the local dynamical spin response as a function of both bias voltage and tip-flux separation, reflecting the $π$ phase acquired by Majorana trajectories encircling the flux. We show that large-scale exact diagonalization of the Kitaev honeycomb model and a complementary low-energy continuum theory yield consistent radial oscillations. These results provide a finite-energy, spatially resolved tunneling signature of a preexisting flux and a diagnostic of fermion-flux mutual statistics without requiring manipulation of individual anyons in the Kitaev spin liquid.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了Kitaev自旋液体中孤立π通量对中性Majorana费米子连续谱的Aharonov-Bohm-like干涉效应，并提出利用STM-IETS作为空间分辨的探测手段来观测这一振荡信号，从而无需操控任意子即可诊断费米子-通量互统计关系。
AI.motivation: 在Kitaev自旋液体中，识别涌现的通量激发及其与巡游Majorana费米子之间的互统计关系仍是一个核心挑战。现有方法往往需要操纵单个任意子，实验上难以实现。
AI.method: 作者通过理论分析证明孤立π通量会在电荷中性的Majorana连续谱上印刻固有的Aharonov-Bohm-like干涉图样；利用STM-IETS在空间分辨的局域动力学自旋响应中探测该振荡（随偏压和针尖-通量距离变化）；并采用大规模精确对角化Kitaev蜂窝模型及互补的低能连续场论进行验证。
AI.result: 大规模精确对角化和低能连续场论给出了一致的径向振荡行为，证实了Majorana轨迹环绕通量所获得的π相位所导致的干涉效应。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作提供了有限能量下、空间分辨的隧道谱学信号来识别预先存在的通量，并为诊断费米子-通量互统计提供了一种无需操控单个任意子的新途径。

title: Fidelity susceptibility of Su-Schrieffer-Heeger model with further neighbour hopping term
summary: In this study, topological phase transition in Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) model with a further neighbour hopping term has been studied in terms of fidelity susceptibility. Topological phase transition point in the standard SSH model has been identified before by noting the divergence of fidelity susceptibility. The same approach has been employed here where fidelity susceptibility is found to diverge at the phase transition points. Additionally, effect of staggered potential on the fidelity susceptibility has been explored. Analytic expression for fidelity susceptibility has been obtained along with its numerical estimation on finite chains by exact diagonalization. Fidelity susceptibility exhibits sharp peaks at the phase transition points in both approaches. Scaling exponent of this divergence has been obtained numerically which is found to agree to that of the standard SSH model without further neighbour terms.

AI.tldr: 本文利用保真度的敏感性（fidelity susceptibility）研究了含次近邻跳跃项的Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH)模型中的拓扑相变。研究发现保真度敏感性在相变点处发散，并与标准SSH模型具有相同的标度指数。此外还探讨了交错势对保真度敏感性的影响。
AI.motivation: 标准SSH模型中的拓扑相变已通过保真度敏感性的发散来识别，本文旨在将该方法推广到含次近邻跳跃项的SSH模型中，并进一步探究交错势的影响。
AI.method: 解析推导保真度敏感性的表达式，同时通过精确对角化在有限链上进行数值估计。两种方法均在相变点处观察到尖锐的保真度敏感性峰值，并数值提取发散标度指数。
AI.result: 保真度敏感性在拓扑相变点处发散，解析与数值结果一致（均出现尖锐峰），且标度指数与不含次近邻项的标准SSH模型一致。
AI.conclusion: 保真度敏感性方法可有效应用于含次近邻跳跃项的SSH模型，证明该方法的普适性；交错势的作用已在文中探讨，但结论需结合全文进一步解读。

title: Nudged Elastic Band Method in the CRYSTAL code. Theory and Applications
summary: The nudged elastic band (NEB) method is a widely used algorithm for determining minimum energy paths and transition states in chemical reactions and phase transitions. In this work, we present the implementation of different NEB algorithm schemes in the CRYSTAL code, a quantum mechanical ab initio program for the calculation of electronic properties of condensed matter systems, based on Hartree-Fock and density functional theory. The use of a set of localized Gaussian-type functions to expand the wavefunction permits a very efficient evaluation of the exact exchange series for the hybrid exchange-correlation functionals. Therefore, our implementation allows an accurate characterization of transition states in both molecular and condensed phase systems, at the hybrid functional level of theory. The theoretical framework, including the force projection scheme, tangent estimation, optimization strategies, as well as the extensions of the method with climbing image and variable spring constant variants, is recalled. Then, the NEB algorithm is validated through a series of benchmark tests: two molecular reactions (a collinear proton transfer process and the keto-enol tautomerization in formamide) and a proton exchange process in a periodic chabazite zeolite. Our results are in excellent agreement with experimental and previous theoretical data, confirming the accuracy and applicability of the implementation. This work opens the possibility for future studies of complex reactive processes on extended periodic systems, using hybrid functionals.

AI.tldr: 本文在CRYSTAL代码中实现了多种爬坡弹性带（NEB）算法方案，基于Hartree-Fock和密度泛函理论的量子化学框架，利用局域高斯型函数高效计算杂化交换泛函，并通过对分子反应和周期性沸石体系的基准测试验证了该实现的准确性和适用性。
AI.motivation: NEB方法广泛用于寻找化学反应和相变中的最小能量路径及过渡态，但在周期性凝聚态体系中使用杂化泛函进行精确过渡态表征仍面临挑战，亟需在CRYSTAL代码中实现高效的NEB算法。
AI.method: 在CRYSTAL代码中实现了多种NEB算法方案，包括力投影方案、切线估计、优化策略，并扩展了爬坡镜像（climbing image）和可变弹簧常数变体；利用局域高斯型函数基组高效计算精确交换系列，实现杂化泛函级别的过渡态表征。
AI.result: 通过三个基准测试验证：线性质子转移反应、甲酰胺的酮-烯醇互变异构以及周期性菱沸石中的质子交换过程，结果与实验及先前理论数据高度一致，证实了实现的准确性和适用性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作在CRYSTAL代码中成功实现了结合杂化泛函的NEB算法，为未来在扩展周期体系中使用杂化泛函研究复杂反应过程开辟了可能性。

title: Electrostatic control of Li+ density and transport rate in double-gated van der Waals devices
summary: Ion transport in crystalline hosts is controlled by an applied potential that simultaneously sets ionic distribution and transport rate, restricting operation to a one-dimensional control space. Here we show that the transport rate of Li+ ions in double-gated van der Waals devices can be modulated while the system occupies fixed ionic-density states. We measure the ionic current along the van der Waals interface between hexagonal boron nitride and graphene or MoS2 while simultaneously monitoring the in-plane electronic response. The ionic current exhibits pronounced hysteresis, with plateaus marking discrete ionic-density states balanced by electronic charge, while an independently tuneable electrochemical-potential drop controls the ionic transport rate. The devices sustain over 1,000 switching cycles and function as hybrid ionic-electronic transistors capable of logic operations and memory retention, with ON/OFF ratios exceeding two orders of magnitude. This work demonstrates a two-dimensional control space for ion transport in layered materials, opening new operating regimes for energy storage and ion-based computing.

AI.tldr: 本文展示了在双栅极范德华器件中，通过独立调控电化学势降，可在固定离子密度态下调节Li+离子传输速率，开辟了二维控制空间，实现了超过两个数量级开关比的混合离子-电子晶体管。
AI.motivation: 传统离子传输只受单一外加电势控制，离子分布和传输速率被耦合在同一个一维控制空间中，限制了离子调控的自由度和应用潜力。
AI.method: 采用双栅极范德华器件，在六方氮化硼与石墨烯或MoS2的范德华界面测量离子电流，同时监测面内电子响应；通过独立调控电化学势降来控制离子传输速率，同时保持离子密度态固定。
AI.result: 离子电流表现出显著迟滞，平台对应由电子电荷平衡的离散离子密度态；器件可承受超过1000次开关循环，ON/OFF比超过两个数量级，并支持逻辑运算和存储功能。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明了层状材料中离子传输的二维控制空间，为能源存储和基于离子的计算开辟了新的工作模式。

title: Impact of interstitial carbon on local lattice distortions in CoCrFeMnNi high-entropy alloys
summary: Here, we explore component-dependent local lattice distortions in polycrystalline, equiatomic, face-centered cubic CrMnFeCoNi high-entropy alloys and their modifications induced by dilute interstitial carbon. Multi-edge extended X-ray absorption fine structure spectroscopy combined with reverse Monte Carlo analysis reveals that the Cr component experiences the most substantial local distortions, independent of the temperature of prolonged annealing treatments (993 K or 1373 K) and the nominal carbon content (0 to 0.8 at.%). The static disorder around Cr atoms was found to increase markedly and monotonically upon carbon alloying, whereas Mn, Fe, Co, and Ni demonstrate weaker and non-monotonic tendencies. The carbon-induced lattice distortions extend over several coordination shells, indicating the pronounced effect of the carbon presence on the local environment around Cr absorbers. First-principles density functional theory and finite-temperature molecular dynamics simulations confirm the greater impact of carbon on the local lattice distortions around Cr than around the other $3d$ constituent elements, based on the previous finding that carbon preferentially occupies Cr-rich interstitial sites. These results provide decisive hints towards the atomistic origin of the non-monotonic diffusion behavior previously reported for carbon-doped CrMnFeCoNi alloys, and are noticeable for understanding the carbon-induced phase transitions in compositionally complex systems.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过多边EXAFS光谱结合逆蒙特卡洛分析，揭示了CrMnFeCoNi高熵合金中Cr元素承受最大的局部晶格畸变，且碳合金化会使Cr周围的静态无序度显著单调增加，而其他元素（Mn、Fe、Co、Ni）则表现出较弱且非单调的趋势。DFT和有限温度MD模拟证实碳优先占据Cr-rich间隙位，进一步放大了Cr周围的局部畸变。
AI.motivation: 理解高熵合金中成分依赖的局部晶格畸变及其受间隙碳元素修饰的机制，从而解释碳掺杂CrMnFeCoNi合金中先前观测到的非单调扩散行为以及碳诱导的相变现象。
AI.method: 采用多边扩展X射线吸收精细结构谱（EXAFS）结合逆蒙特卡洛（RMC）分析，对993 K和1373 K退火处理的CrMnFeCoNi合金（含0-0.8 at.%碳）进行局部畸变表征；并通过第一性原理密度泛函理论（DFT）和有限温度分子动力学（MD）模拟进行验证。
AI.result: Cr元素承受最大的局部晶格畸变，与退火温度和碳含量无关。碳合金化使Cr周围静态无序度显著单调增加，而其他3d元素呈较弱的非单调变化。碳诱导的畸变延伸到多个配位壳层，对Cr吸收体周围局部环境影响显著。模拟结果证实碳优先占据Cr-rich位点，对Cr畸变的影响大于其他元素。
AI.conclusion: 碳在CrMnFeCoNi合金中优先占据Cr-rich间隙位并显著放大Cr周围的局部晶格畸变，这一发现为碳掺杂合金的非单调扩散行为提供了原子层面的解释，对理解组成复杂系统中碳诱导的相变具有重要意义。

title: A test drive for exchange-correlation functionals on noncollinear magnets: Mn$_3$Ir, Mn$_3$Ge, NiS$_2$, and YMnO$_3$
summary: A first-principles description of noncollinear magnets is challenging, and the practical behavior of genuinely noncollinear exchange-correlation approximations is largely untested. Spin-current density-functional theory (SCDFT) admits noncollinear approximations constrained by local U(1)$\times$SU(2) gauge invariance, an exact condition unavailable in the more restrictive framework of spin-DFT (SDFT). Using the Vienna ab initio simulation package (VASP), we compare two recently developed noncollinear SCDFT functionals, NCMSCAN and LFNCBR89-NCCS, against locally collinear SDFT extensions of four common functionals (PZ, PW92, PBE, and SCAN) for several noncollinear $d$-electron systems. The key finding is that among all tested functionals, only the SCDFT functionals recover the spin texture of the experimental ground state of NiS$_2$, and they do so at a cost comparable to standard semi-local approximations. Yet the two SCDFT functionals differ in equilibrium volumes, band gaps, and on-site magnetic moments. Overall, this survey illustrates the usefulness of SCDFT in capturing noncollinear physics with the tested approximations.

AI.tldr: 本文使用VASP比较了两种非共线SCDFT泛函（NCMSCAN和LFNCBR89-NCCS）与四种SDFT泛函在非共线d电子体系中的表现，发现只有SCDFT泛函能恢复NiS₂实验基态的磁织构，且计算成本与标准半局域近似相当。
AI.motivation: 非共线磁体的第一性原理描述具有挑战性，真正的非共线交换关联近似实用性未被充分测试；SDFT框架限制严格，而SCDFT允许由U(1)×SU(2)规范不变性约束的非共线近似，这是SDFT中不具备的精确条件。
AI.method: 在VASP中实现并对比两种新开发的非共线SCDFT泛函（NCMSCAN和LFNCBR89-NCCS）与四种常用泛函（PZ、PW92、PBE、SCAN）的局域共线SDFT扩展，应用于多个非共线d电子体系。
AI.result: 在所有测试泛函中，仅SCDFT泛函恢复了NiS₂实验基态的磁织构，且计算成本与标准半局域近似相当；但两个SCDFT泛函在平衡体积、带隙和局域磁矩上存在差异。
AI.conclusion: 该调查表明SCDFT在捕捉非共线物理方面具有实用性，测试的近似泛函能够有效描述非共线磁性。

title: Enhanced intrinsic spin-orbit driving of a Loss-DiVincenzo qubit near the spin-valley hotspot in Si/SiGe
summary: In most Si/SiGe-based spin qubit implementations, high-fidelity single-qubit gates are achieved using micromagnets, which enable the use of electric spin dipole resonance via synthetic spin-orbit coupling (s-SOC). In contrast, intrinsic spin-orbit coupling (i-SOC) in silicon is generally considered to be weak. However, in Si/SiGe heterostructures, theory predicts a substantial enhancement when the Zeeman splitting approaches the valley splitting if symmetry is reduced by an imperfect interface. Here, we demonstrate a Si/SiGe Loss-DiVincenzo qubit driven by i-SOC close to this so-called spin-valley hotspot. In particular, we characterize the Rabi frequency as a function of the energy detuning from the hotspot by sweeping both the magnetic field and quantum dot position. We observe the predicted enhancement of the Rabi frequency near the hotspot, but also find an asymmetry that deviates from existing theoretical models as well as distortions of the Chevron patterns near the hotspot. While we achieve an average single-qubit Clifford fidelity of 98.6 %, the strong variability of the valley splitting may impede the use of i-SOC-based control as a scalable operational strategy; understanding its effect is nevertheless important for reproducible high-fidelity control. Our results provide an empirical basis for refining current theoretical models of spin-valley physics in Si/SiGe heterostructures.

AI.tldr: 本研究在Si/SiGe异质结构中演示了由本征自旋轨道耦合（i-SOC）驱动的Loss-DiVincenzo量子比特，工作在自旋-谷热点附近。实验观察到拉比频率在热点附近增强，但发现与现有理论模型不符的不对称性以及Chevron图案的畸变。虽然平均单量子比特Clifford保真度达到98.6%，但谷劈裂的强变异性可能阻碍基于i-SOC的控制策略的可扩展应用。
AI.motivation: 传统Si/SiGe自旋量子比特依赖微磁铁产生合成自旋轨道耦合（s-SOC）来实现高保真单量子比特门，而硅中的本征自旋轨道耦合（i-SOC）通常被认为很弱。然而理论预测，在Zeeman劈裂接近谷劈裂且界面非理想（对称性降低）时，i-SOC可被大幅增强。作者希望通过实验验证这一"自旋-谷热点"附近的增强效应，并评估其作为可扩展量子比特控制策略的可行性。
AI.method: 实验使用Si/SiGe Loss-DiVincenzo自旋量子比特，通过同时扫描磁场和量子点位置来表征拉比频率随与热点能量失谐量的变化关系，从而系统研究i-SOC驱动下的自旋操控行为及其在热点附近的特性。
AI.result: 实验观察到在自旋-谷热点附近拉比频率的预期增强，但发现了与现有理论模型不一致的不对称性，并在热点附近观察到Chevron图案的畸变。实现的平均单量子比特Clifford保真度为98.6%。
AI.conclusion: i-SOC驱动的量子比特控制虽然可行，但谷劈裂的强变异性可能限制了其作为可扩展操作策略的应用。然而，对这一效应的深入理解对于实现可重复的高保真控制至关重要，实验结果也为改进Si/SiGe异质结构中的自旋-谷物理理论模型提供了经验基础。

title: Quantum Geometry Driven Optical Responses in 1T-MX$_2$ Monolayers: A Symmetry-Constrained Slater-Koster Tight-Binding Approach
comment: 14 pages, 8 figures, comments are most welcome
summary: Centrosymmetric 1T-MX$_2$ monolayers(MLs) have attracted considerable attention owing to their intriguing transport properties and potential technological applications arising from the interplay among quantum geometry, electronic band structure, and band-gap characteristics. Despite this rich physics, a comprehensive microscopic tight-binding(TB) description that simultaneously captures these properties remains insufficiently established, while first-principles approaches can be computationally demanding for systematic investigations across different materials and perturbations. Here, we develop a transferable eleven-band Slater-Koster TB description of ML 1T-MX$_2$ TMDs and use it to establish a connection among their microscopic electronic structure, quantum geometry, and optical response. The model is constructed in an orthogonal orbital basis from the crystal geometry and symmetry-constrained SK parameters, with material-specific parametrizations obtained from DFT calculations for ML ZrS$_2$ and HfS$_2$. The resulting geometry-based Hamiltonian accurately describes the low-energy electronic structures and provides a natural framework for extending the analysis to the broader isostructural 1T-MX$_2$ family. We find that the pristine MLs possess a finite quantum metric, with the dominant contribution concentrated in the two highest occupied bands owing to the small near-gap energy separation and strong metal-chalcogen $p$-$d$ hybridization. Furthermore, we verify the interband $f$-sum rule, which directly relates the integrated optical spectral weight to the Brillouin-zone-averaged quantum metric. Our results establish optical spectral weight as an experimentally accessible probe of the quantum geometry of occupied Bloch states and provide a unified microscopic framework for connecting electronic structure, quantum geometry, and measurable optical responses across the 1T-MX$_2$ family.

AI.tldr: 本文发展了一种可迁移的十一带Slater-Koster紧束缚模型，用于描述单层1T-MX₂过渡金属二硫族化物，并建立了其微观电子结构、量子几何与光学响应之间的联系。模型以正交轨道基和对称约束参数构建，基于DFT计算对ZrS₂和HfS₂进行参数化。研究发现原始单层具有有限量子度量，主要贡献集中在两个最高占据带，并验证了带间f求和规则，将积分光学谱权直接关联到布里渊区平均量子度量。
AI.motivation: 1T-MX₂单层具有丰富的量子几何、电子能带结构和带隙特性相互作用的物理，但目前缺乏能够同时捕捉这些性质的全面微观紧束缚描述。第一性原理方法在不同材料和扰动的系统研究中计算成本过高，需要一种可迁移且高效的模型来建立统一的分析框架。
AI.method: 作者在正交轨道基下，从晶体几何和对称约束的Slater-Koster参数构建十一带紧束缚模型，并从DFT计算获得ZrS₂和HfS₂单层的材料特定参数化。基于该几何哈密顿量分析低能电子结构、量子度量分布，并通过带间f求和规则将光学谱权与量子度量建立联系。
AI.result: 模型准确描述了低能电子结构；原始单层具有有限量子度量，主导贡献来自两个最高占据带（归因于近隙能量分离小和强的金属-硫族p-d杂化）；验证了带间f求和规则，建立了光学谱权与布里渊区平均量子度量之间的直接关系。
AI.conclusion: 光学谱权可作为实验可及的量量子几何探针，该框架为连接整个1T-MX₂家族的电子结构、量子几何和可测量光学响应提供了统一的微观描述。

title: Insight into the molecular dynamics of barocaloric molecular crystals using quasi-elastic neutron scattering
comment: Main manuscript (19 pages 5 figures) followed by supplementary information (15 pages 19 figures)
summary: Barocaloric (BC) molecular crystals exhibit order-disorder phase transitions that o9er a promising basis for solid-state heating and cooling. However, rational design of these next-generation materials requires microscopic understanding of the molecular dynamics that drive the transitional entropy change. Quasi-elastic neutron scattering (QENS) techniques including inelastic fixed-window scans (IFWSs) enable the direct probing of such molecular motions throughout thermodynamic phase transitions. Here we present a QENS-IFWS global fitting methodology for systematically investigating the molecular dynamics underpinning BC performance in molecular crystals. We demonstrate this methodology on neopentyl glycol (NPG) and three derivatives spanning chemically distinct routes to dynamical perturbation. By fixing attempt frequencies across samples, we observe measurable differences in the relative activation energies and mobile fractions of hydroxymethyl and full-molecular rotations. The largest observed e9ect is on the hydroxymethyl rotation activation energies, which is closely related to hydrogen bond network stability, ranging from -3.6% to +11.1% in the derivatives compared to pure NPG. The capability of this global fitting strategy to extract subtle variations in molecular rotations highlights QENS as a versatile design tool for guiding BC molecular crystal design.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于准弹性中子散射（QENS）和固定窗口扫描（IFWS）的全局拟合方法，系统研究压热（BC）分子晶体中驱动相变熵变的分子动力学机制，并在新戊二醇及其三种衍生物上验证该方法，揭示了羟甲基旋转活化能随氢键网络稳定性的变化（-3.6%至+11.1%）。
AI.motivation: 压热分子晶体具有有序-无序相变，是固态加热/冷却器件的潜力材料，但缺乏对驱动相变熵变的分子动力学的微观理解，阻碍了这类材料的理性设计。
AI.method: 开发了一种QENS-IFWS全局拟合方法，通过在所有样品中固定尝试频率，比较不同衍生物之间分子旋转的相对活化能和移动分数，从而分离并量化羟甲基旋转与整体分子旋转的动力学差异。
AI.result: 在NPG及其三种衍生物中观察到羟甲基与全分子旋转的活化能和移动分数存在可测差异；对羟甲基旋转活化能的影响最为显著，变化范围从-3.6%到+11.1%，该变化与氢键网络稳定性密切相关。
AI.conclusion: 该全局拟合策略能够提取分子旋转的细微差异，表明QENS可作为指导压热分子晶体设计的通用设计工具。
